level1_releases.name: v2.1.332
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## What's changed

- Added skills from MCP servers (beta). They show as `server:skill` in the `/` menu; other skills keep their names
- Added a `PreSkillShellCommand` hook event that can refuse a skill or command's inline shell commands as it loads; on 2.1.331 and older, a settings file naming it opens a dialog at start
- Added "Always deliver" to the prompt for held messages from other sessions
- Added a footer line that stays while a flagged message has your session on a different model, until you pick one with `/model`
- Added an OpenTelemetry `assistant_response` event for text Claude sends through SendUserMessage or Cowork's message tool, when response logging is on
- Added a warning in VS Code and Desktop's Code tab when part of a session couldn't be saved, saying how to save it with `/compact`
- Added a notice in VS Code and Desktop's Code tab when a resumed session's earlier messages weren't loaded, as the terminal already shows
- Added your Cyber Verification Program access tier to the startup header, beside the model name when your tier applies to that model and you're signed in with a claude.ai account
- Fixed `claude auth login` reporting `Login successful.` when a claude.ai login could not be saved: it now exits 1 and says what to check, such as a leftover lock file or a full disk
- Fixed Read, @-mentions and compaction hanging on a named pipe that nothing writes to, such as a `.env` mounted by a locked secrets manager; the read now fails after 20 seconds
- Fixed turns ending in "Prompt is too long" after repeated auto-compaction failures when one more compaction at the context limit could have kept them going
- Fixed compaction failing when a summary kept running past the output limit: after three cut-off replies, the last try now asks for a shorter summary
- Fixed a freeze when a permission rule or hook condition with several wildcards was checked against a long command
- Fixed freezes and runaway memory use in most cases while a hook prints output without end
- Fixed a freeze and context overflow when a hook blocks or fails during a turn, or after `/compact`, with a very large log; text over about 50,000 characters is now shortened
- Fixed the terminal freezing, and ignoring Ctrl+C, while a local MCP server floods its standard output
- Fixed a freeze when a prompt or piped input holds an `@` followed by a very long unbroken string, such as minified CSS with an embedded font
- Fixed a long freeze when opening a rewind point after a large tra

level1_releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.23.4
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.4

**Release Date:** November 23, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~229 PRs merged since v0.23.3 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `8fc03744473`, the window since v0.23.3 contains **1,122 non-merge commits** across **1,316 changed files** (+96,873 / −6,703), **229 merged PRs** and **281 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Neon and Carbon on Nous Portal, OpenRouter and Vertex, `hermes gateway migrate --backends` to move an old serve/dashboard backend onto the gateway (with a System page card in the dashboard), `hermes plugins config` to edit a plugin's settings from the terminal, approval cards in Desktop for a sandbox's folder and site requests, gateway clients announcing who they are so plugins can see which client sent a turn, a long run of Desktop streaming and transcript performance work, a retryable indicator for slow profile switches, `hermes dashboard password` without a TTY prompt, configurable skill index description length (`skills.index_desc_limit`), managed-scope config honored by security and URL-safety reads, and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.3...v0.23.4](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.3...v0.23.4)

## New Features

- Follow thread links from search results and transcripts to open saved conversations and nested agents in the terminal. (#62332)
- Press `Tab` to complete arguments for supported slash commands. For example, `/mcp lo` completes to `/mcp login`. (#62343)
- Jump between task groups in the agent command center with `Shift+Up` and `Shift+Down`. (#62200)
- Optional stdio MCP servers with cached tool lists now start on their first tool call by default. (#62366)
- Set an approval reviewer for individual connected app tools in `config.toml`. (#62360)
- App-server clients can select Amazon Bedrock Runtime during setup or sign-in. (#62222)

## Bug Fixes

- `codex exec resume` restores saved sandbox permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots unless explicitly overridden. (#62194)
- Remote sessions preserve working directories, workspace roots, and writable paths when the client and server run on different operating systems. (#62375, #62376, #62377)
- Codex reports provider errors as soon as they arrive in a response stream and identifies which API spend limit was reached. (#62329, #62356)
- Interrupting a parent turn preserves queued replies from child agents for the next turn. (#62348)
- Use `PageUp` and `PageDown` to read and submit answer choices that are taller than the terminal’s answer area. (#62209)
- Cloud replies that finish after history loads now update in place, keeping the terminal transcript in order. (#62403)

## Documentation

- The bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migration to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint choices and tool-calling requirements. (#62447)

## Chores

- Code Mode now uses gRPC for all host connections. The `code_mode_host_grpc` setting is deprecated. (#62476)
- Python formatting and SDK type generation now verify dependency hashes against the repository lockfile. (#62346)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.171.0...rust-v0.172.0

- #62190 Route turn and response checkpoints through the rollout budget policy @anp-oai
- #62192 Distinguish Windows sandbox provisioning timeouts and pipe closures @zm-oai
- #62194 Preserve saved sandbox permissions when resuming `codex exec` @viyatb-oai
- #62200 Add task group navigation to the agent command center @bc-openai
- #62202 Omit unknown server versions from `/status` @bc-openai
- #62205 Keep sandbox preparation with the command through launch @viyatb-oai
- #62206 Prevent duplicate initial context when inject
